chunks: As a gift from the forgiving, ever-merciful (God).
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Nuzulan min Ghafurin Rahim' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this fragment highlights the dual nature of divine bestowal, where 'Nuzula' signifies a descent of grace from the elevated status of God to the humble servant. The pairing of Al-Ghafur (focusing on covering faults) and Ar-Rahim (focusing on active mercy) reflects the balanced spiritual path emphasized by the Ahl al-Bayt, ensuring believers receive sustenance through both forgiveness and compassionate provision.
